title: Delivery telemetry ledger record (v1)
description: One record per completed delivery-pipeline issue. Authoritative data only: every field is an observed event (GitHub timestamp/label or a supplied run counter) or arithmetic over authoritative timestamps. No value is inferred, estimated, or guessed.

pr.description: GitHub PR number that closed the issue.

routing.description: design = OpenSpec change; oracle = parity/repro bug.

cycle_time_s.description: closed_at - created_at, in seconds (arithmetic over authoritative timestamps).

claim_collisions.description: Run-observed: number of rejected claim pushes (a competing session won the race).

rebase_events.description: Run-observed: number of rebases / merge-conflict resolutions.

gate_runs.description: Run-observed: number of agent-gate.sh runs through (and including) the first PASS — runs stop at the first pass, so failed rounds = gate_runs-1 for a terminal pass and gate_runs for a terminal fail. Do not re-run the gate after a pass.

roborev_findings.description: Run-observed: count of roborev findings raised.

stamped_at.description: Wall-clock when finalize wrote this record (observed at write time).
